findings.summary: The control-plane Python launch does not use the shared executable resolver or bind the interpreter identity at planning/admission.
evidence: runner.py invokes bind_control_interpreter(sys.executable) immediately before launching verify.py.
verification_sandbox.py validates and hashes the active interpreter path but does not call resolve_executable or compare against a plan/admission binding.

The active T-003 packet requires one resolver for backend, allowlisted-command, and control-plane Python launches, with resolved executable paths and SHA-256 digests bound at planning/admission and rechecked at launch.
findings.impact: The control interpreter is checked at launch time only; a binary change after planning is not rejected against the accepted plan binding. This leaves the control-plane launch outside the accepted VC-016 executable-resolution contract.
findings.required_action: Use the shared resolver for the control-plane interpreter and bind its canonical path and digest to the accepted plan/admission, then verify that binding immediately before launch. Add regression coverage for a post-planning interpreter swap.

findings.summary: The evaluator-side backend-discovery test still mocks shutil.which although discovery uses the shared resolver.
evidence: That test is outside T-003 allowed_paths and packet verification commands; Docker presence determines whether its current assertions still pass.
findings.impact: The discovery assertion is unreliable and may pass without exercising the mock on Docker hosts, or fail on hosts without Docker. It does not alter production behavior.
findings.required_action: Keep as a T-900 evaluator follow-up; do not change it in the T-003 repair.

positive_evidence.payload_executable_bindings: Plan and authority bind payload executable paths and digests; launch-time swap refusal is covered.
positive_evidence.environment_and_case_handling: Injection filtering and case-insensitive .git/.agent-state protection were inspected without a counterexample.

scope: Scoped independent follow-up review of completed T-003 only. This is not the global T-900 evaluation and does not qualify or complete T-900.
